statements.t: “Since mid-September, we have announced our cooperation with apM Group in Korea, our entry into an agreement to acquire Hexa Creation Inc., and an AI infrastructure services agreement that we expect to generate over US$100 million in revenue over the next five years, subject to satisfaction of certain closing conditions.

The Company expects to report its complete financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026 in its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q, which it expects to file with the Securities and Exchange Commission on or before November 16, 2026.
By leveraging emerging technologies, the Company aims to drive diversification and long-term value creation.
